hero.lead_before: In the 2025/2026 school year, Escola Betel served
hero.lead_after: in the Cacine Sector, providing comprehensive education from Kindergarten to High School, housing, daily meals, health care, and digital inclusion for the Nalu People.

projects_section.p: Escola Betel operates in 3 shifts (Kindergarten to 12th Grade) integrating education, daily meals, sustainable infrastructure, and health to transform families in Cacine.

school.title: Escola Betel (3 Shifts)
school.text: 845 students served from Kindergarten to High School (12th Grade). 704 students passed in the 2025/2026 school year.

housing.title: Student House (Boarding)
housing.text: 20 boarding spots for vulnerable students from distant villages, with tutoring, housing, and meals.

radio.title: Voice of Peace Radio (107.7 MHz)
radio.text: 'Betel on the Air' program hosted by Prof. Alfa Djaló, promoting education and community awareness.

water.title: School Canteen & Clean Water
water.text: Daily free meals for Primary School (often the child's only daily meal) + dental care with NGO Mundo a Sorrir.

digital.title: Digital Inclusion & Solar Energy
digital.text: Solar power system and Starlink Internet donated by Sweden + Computer Course with Prof. Alfa Djaló.

sports.title: Betel Sports Gymnasium
sports.text: Construction in progress: land clearing, leveling, and foundation 100% completed. Roof structure next.

map.p: Active focus in the Cacine Sector and 91 southern villages, supported by sponsors from Hungary, Sweden, Brazil, Canada, Portugal, and Senegal.

story.h2: Voices of those living the transformation
story.video_title: Watch the Official Testimonial from Cacine
story.video_desc: See how education, school meals, and infrastructure are bearing real fruit in the lives of children and teachers.
story.blockquote: "Immensely grateful to God and to you for the privilege of serving our people through Transformative Education!"
story.author_1: Pr. José Valberto T. Oliveira (Director of Escola Betel)
story.blockquote_2: "The school canteen guarantees the only daily meal for many of our children, increasing school attendance and learning."
story.p: Each partnership shortens distances, protects dreams, and multiplies community leaders in southern Guinea-Bissau.

transparency.p: Check the real progress of projects recorded in the 2025/2026 Official Report of Escola Betel de Cacine.
checks: 845 students enrolled: 490 boys and 355 girls (704 passed)

campaign.p: Foundation and footings are ready! The next step is raising the roof structure as soon as the material container arrives in Cacine.
campaign.progress_text: Help fund the roof structure and sports flooring for our 845 students.
